quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a predictive flight delay insurance that automatically pays out before your flight lands.
quests.correctAnswer: Our insurance monitors live flight data and pays automatically the moment a delay threshold is reached - no form to fill in and no dispute to navigate.
quests.hint: Lead with the pre-emptive automatic payout.
quests.explanation: Removing the claims process entirely is a fundamental reimagination of insurance and is highly memorable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI travel itinerary builder that adapts plans in real time when weather or events change.

quests.hint: Highlight the live adaptive replanning capability.
quests.explanation: Live adaptation to disruptions solves the most stressful aspect of international travel in a single product.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.hint: Lead with the transparent side-by-side comparison.
quests.explanation: Transparent comparison empowers informed decision-making rather than imposing a specific sustainable choice.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.hint: Lead with the bold double-the-difference guarantee.
quests.explanation: A specific over-compensation guarantee creates stronger trust than a standard price-match promise.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.explanation: Positioning against the hotel experience by highlighting what hotels structurally cannot provide is effective differentiation.

quests.explanation: Waterway commuting is an underused urban transport layer and electric ferries represent a genuinely compelling innovation.
